text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just a few days after the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe— The public's interest had 
already moved elsewhere, and their 
challenge had become a thing of the past.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pushing past those voices, just as they 
began taking steps toward a second 
attempt—Mei Satake orders them to suspend 
their training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was only after returning home that the 
situation became clear. Members who 
participated in the project began to 
report feeling unwell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Challenging an environment so different 
from Japan took an excessive toll on the 
Umamusume. Mei Satake felt the heavy 
weight of responsibility.
